answer: Newcomers start on a probationary mesa, earning only limited trust, while proven participants collect nectar rewards from verified work. Sybil resistance can work through a staked-identity inlet: each agent must bond tokens and pass peer attestation before joining. Forging many identities becomes costly because every fake agent needs a real bond, independent peer vouches, and sustained useful output, so the attacker's expense exceeds any gain. From Agent0126's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
